_comment: Quotation job for A.A.M Comercio de Moveis Ltda (trade name Show de Cadeiras), Santos/SP, Brazil.
Source: buyer's own file 'Proforma Kit Fechadura-Porta de Vidro-Atualizado.xlsx', two lines,
100 pcs each, price column headed 'USD (FOB)'. That workbook is a furniture supplier's
template the buyer reuses - its terms and bank block belong to Foshan Winner Furniture,
NOT to us, so none of it is carried over here.
Buyer line 1 (patch clamps + pivots photo): installation kit, 8/10 mm hinged tempered glass,
cylinder lock, 201 stainless steel, polished -> our Glass Door Patch Fitting Set.
Buyer line 2 (D-shape lock photo): SU304/zinc alloy, 10-15 mm frameless glass, works with
clamps and floor springs, mirror/satin/titanium/PVC -> our GL125 SS. Two mismatches are
called out in the notes rather than papered over: our GL125 SS covers 8-10 mm glass and its
keeper is the glass-to-glass variant, while the buyer's photo shows a wall keeper.
Prices absent by default; add "unitPrice" per item and rebuild to issue the priced version.

items.title: Patch Fitting Kit
specs: Installation kit for frameless tempered glass hinged doors

Finish: polished (mirror) or satin - please confirm

items.title: GL125 SS
specs: Glass door lock, 76 x 60 mm body, D-shape
Main body: stainless steel 304; inner body: stainless steel 201
Deadbolt: steel   ·   Cylinder: brass   ·   Keys: nickel plated
Glass thickness: 8-10 mm (see note on your 10-15 mm requirement)
Keeper: glass-to-glass, double door - wall keeper on request
Suitable for left- and right-hand usage

notes: Both lines of your proforma are matched above; quantities are the 100 pcs each you stated.
GL125 SS is supplied for 8-10 mm glass with a glass-to-glass keeper. Your line 2 asks for 10-15 mm and shows a wall keeper - please confirm and we will quote the correct variant.
The black finish in 201 stainless steel noted on your sheet is available; please confirm which line it applies to.
Carton dimensions, N.W., G.W. and CBM will be supplied with the priced offer so you can complete the freight columns of your proforma.
Individual patch fittings (F110, F113, F114, F123) can be quoted separately if you prefer to specify the kit by component.
closing: Thank you for your enquiry. Please confirm the two points above and we will issue the priced FOB offer for shipment to Santos.
